decisions.reason: A niche agricultural crate that kept its website mention through 2019 fits the core reusable-packaging business, and as a large firm management has the slack to carry it without signs of an aspiration shortfall.
Its dedicated page in both years suggests results at or above aspiration in the central large-container segment, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
A stackable crate is a staple range item with steady visibility and broad demand across food, retail and industry, so it likely meets aspirations.
A medium-duty rackable pallet complements the core pallet line and showed stable presence, giving no reason to divert its resources.
Its move from its own page to a mere mention hints at weaker-than-hoped results in a niche, but the firm's slack lets it keep carrying the product for now.
Its reduced website prominence signals some shortfall against aspiration, yet it is cheap to keep as a variant within the pallet range, so dropping it is not yet warranted.
